verification.projectIndexContent: No staged changes; git diff --cached --exit-code passed. Index byte hash changed during status checks, so byte identity is not claimed.

changes: Create real Git history from selected workspace files without requiring prior staging, or from selected staged content
Require a single-line summary with an optional description; preserve unselected worktree and index content
Use an isolated commit index, retain hooks, and report post-commit index synchronization warnings truthfully
Separate read-only previews from global mutation busy state; cache, deduplicate, prefetch and ignore stale requests
Avoid whole-repository status scans when identifying the selected untracked diff target
Align selection checkbox, count and icon toolbar with file rows
Show real per-file additions/deletions with explicit binary, large and unknown states
warnings: Existing agent.extension and renderer.extension permissions require explicit user grant; no permissions added
limitations: Manual reload or package installation is required; browser tests do not constitute native PI-Desktop window acceptance
Workspace statistics compare index to worktree; staged statistics compare HEAD to index
External edits require explicit refresh to invalidate preview cache
Hooks and filters remain trusted local code and may modify files
External index updates during commit are retained and require user review when a success notice reports them
